brief: A phone charging station: a closed box with a cover that lets a cable pass through.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single full hex base (piece:0,0,0;full) with all 6 side faces closed by solid caps (cap:0,0,0;*;*) and top and bottom closed by covers (cover:0,0,0;full;top and cover:0,0,0;full;bottom) forming a sealed 1-storey box ~220x80x218mm.

requirements.requirement: Cover that lets a cable pass through
requirements.evidence: Top cover set to type cable (cover:0,0,0;full;top stem cable) which provides cable entry slots through the closed top; bottom remains plain to close the box. Demonstrated with phone prop (prop:1) on top surface f3 visible from above (look polar 10).

finish.summary: Built 1-cell closed box with 6 solid caps and plain bottom cover, topped with cable-type cover for cable passthrough; phone staged on top to show charging-station use. check_build clear, no mesh clash.

events.text: A closed charging box with a cable port — I'll get it configured.
